onboarding.s1Title: Hear what each bark might mean
onboarding.s1Body: Record a bark and get a playful, AI-assisted read on your dog's likely mood and intent — with honest confidence levels.
onboarding.s2Body: Type or say a phrase and play it back as a fun bark in a small, medium or big dog voice.
onboarding.s3Title: Play, train and share the fun
onboarding.s3Body: Games for dogs, step-by-step training, mood diary and AI portraits. Turn any moment into a shareable video.

profile.name: Dog's name
profile.breedHint: Type it or pick one below. You can skip this.
profile.photoHint: Used for the profile, AI scanner and portraits. You can change it anytime.

errors.not_configured: The online service isn't set up yet. Local tools still work.
errors.offline: You seem to be offline. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unauthorized: We couldn't start a session. Please try again.
errors.free_limit_reached: You've used today's free analyses. Go Pro for more.
errors.daily_limit_reached: You've reached today's limit. Please come back tomorrow.
errors.audio_too_quiet_or_short: That recording was too short or too quiet. Try again closer to your dog.
errors.image_too_large: That photo is too large. Try a different one.
errors.unsupported_image: That image format isn't supported. Use a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo.
errors.ai_not_configured: The AI service isn't set up yet.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.unsupported_audio: Only WAV files can be imported for now. Record directly, or convert your file to WAV.
errors.audio_too_long: That file is longer than 30 seconds. Trim it and try again.

home.noMoodBody: Record a bark to start {{name}}'s mood diary.
home.humanToDogBody: Talk back in a dog-style voice

translate.title: What is {{name}} saying?
translate.hint: Tap to record a bark (up to 10 seconds).
translate.privacy: Your recording stays on your phone and is deleted right after. Only simple measurements (loudness and timing) are sent for analysis.
translate.micBody: Allow microphone access in Settings to record your dog.
translate.disclaimer: Experimental and just for fun. This is an AI-assisted guess from simple sound measurements, not a scientifically validated translation. Watch your dog's body language too.
translate.heading: Tap the mic, then let {{name}} bark
translate.sub: Record up to 10 seconds. We’ll suggest what the bark might mean.
translate.humanSub: Tap the mic and say a phrase like “Come here”. We’ll play it back as a bark.
translate.tip: Best results: quiet room, phone 1–2 m away, one dog barking at a time.
translate.uploadBody: Use a clip of up to 30 seconds. We’ll measure the bark automatically.

history.clearBody: This deletes all saved results for this dog from this phone.

mood.title: Mood diary
mood.disclaimer: These are AI-assisted or self-recorded observations, not objective measurements of your dog's feelings.

training.proOnly: This lesson is part of Pro.
training.humane: Keep sessions short and positive. Never punish or scare your dog.

sounds.title: Pet Sounds
sounds.emptyBody: The library loads licensed sounds from the app's sound pack. Add the audio files and list them in the sound catalogue to enable it.
sounds.noFavorites: No favorites yet. Long-press a sound to add it.
sounds.longPressHint: Long-press to add or remove from favorites

talk.title: Human → Dog
talk.disclaimer: These sounds are playful and may not communicate a phrase to your dog. Watch how your dog reacts.
talk.welfare: Keep volume low, play sounds briefly, and stop if your dog seems stressed.
talk.noPack: The dog-sound pack isn't installed yet, so this phrase has no sound.
talk.noMatch: I didn’t recognise that phrase. Pick one below.
talk.voiceUnavailable: Speech recognition isn’t available, or permission was denied.

games.safety: Supervise play. Not every dog enjoys screen games — stop if your dog is stressed, and don't let them bite or scratch the screen.

quiz.title: Daily quiz
quiz.question: Question {{n}} of {{total}}
quiz.done: You scored {{score}} of {{total}} today. Come back tomorrow!

assistant.title: Dog assistant
assistant.disclaimer: General dog-care and training tips only. I'm not a veterinarian. For urgent symptoms, contact a vet right away.

scanner.title: AI scanner
scanner.disclaimer: Breed guesses are estimates, and a photo can't show how a dog feels. Not veterinary advice.
scanner.permission: Photo access is needed. Enable it in Settings.
scanner.consent: When you tap Analyze, this photo is sent securely for analysis, used once and not stored.
scanner.notDog: We couldn't see a dog in this photo. Try another.

portraits.title: AI portraits
portraits.body: Turn your dog's photo into a stylised portrait. Pro feature.

paywall.title: Everything your dog loves, all in one place
paywall.body: Go Pro for the whole pack.

benefits.ai: Expanded AI translations, scans and chats

paywall.failed: The purchase didn't complete. You haven't been charged.
paywall.unavailable: Plans can't be loaded right now. Check your connection and try again.
paywall.disclosure: Payment is charged to your store account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel any time in your store account settings.

more.privacyNote: Your recordings and photos are never kept. History stays on this phone.
more.deleteAccountBody: This removes your dogs, history and any online account data from this phone and our servers.
more.notificationsDenied: Notifications are turned off. Enable them in Settings.

clicker.title: Clicker
clicker.hint: Tap to click. Mark the exact moment your dog does the right thing, then reward.

whistle.title: Dog whistle
whistle.limitations: Phone speakers may not reproduce very high frequencies reliably. Dogs hear higher than people, so keep volume low, keep sessions short and stop if your dog seems uncomfortable.

reminder.title: Time to train!
reminder.body: A short, fun session with {{name}} keeps skills sharp.
